title: The New One Minute Manager
author: Kenneth H. Blanchard, Spencer Johnson
engineRationale: Book profile (strong): mixed story + argument → leans Antidote for the ideas; contemporary fiction with a cast → staged characters in Antidote (We Were Liars: 0/30 wrong, image adds 70%)

mustSee: a young employee searching for a good manager
a manager at a desk with a one-minute goal sheet
a one-minute praise moment with a smile
a one-minute reprimand that stops at the act, not the person
an employee visibly relieved and motivated

reasons: the narration addresses the viewer ("you" 42.3/1k) → an idea/advice film, drawn as icons, diagrams and an everyman (Antidote)
idea vocabulary 13/1k (habits, decisions, attention, money…) → concepts need icons/diagrams, not photographs (Antidote)
